The '''Falleen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
